versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάνης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας,

controles.web: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
controles.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
controles.livre: E naqueles dias veio João Batista, pregando no deserto da Judeia,

versos.grego: λέγων Μετανοεῖτε· ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
controles.kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
controles.livre: E dizendo: Arrependei-vos, porque perto está o Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying,  “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.”
controles.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
controles.livre: Porque este é aquele que foi declarado pelo profeta Isaías, que disse: Voz do que clama no deserto: “Preparai o caminho do Senhor; endireitai suas veredas”.

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάνης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ· ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

controles.web: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
controles.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
controles.livre: Este João tinha sua roupa de pelos de camelo e um cinto de couro ao redor de sua cintura, e seu alimento era gafanhotos e mel silvestre.

versos.grego: Τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου,

controles.web: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
controles.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the region round about Jordan,
controles.livre: Então vinham até ele moradores de Jerusalém, de toda a Judeia, e de toda a região próxima do Jordão;

versos.grego: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
controles.kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
controles.livre: E eram por ele batizados no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.

versos.grego: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

controles.web: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
controles.kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
controles.livre: Mas quando ele viu muitos dos fariseus e dos saduceus que vinham ao batismo, disse-lhes: Ninhada de víboras! Quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira futura?

versos.grego: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας·

controles.web: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
controles.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
controles.livre: Dai, pois, fruto condizente com o arrependimento.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ· λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

controles.web: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
controles.kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
controles.livre: E não imagineis, dizendo em vós mesmos: “Temos por pai a Abraão”, porque eu vos digo que até destas pedras Deus pode fazer surgir filhos a Abraão.

versos.grego: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

controles.web: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
controles.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
controles.livre: E agora o machado está posto à raiz das árvores; portanto toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν· ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·

controles.web: I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
controles.livre: Realmente eu vos batizo com água para arrependimento, mas aquele que vem após mim é mais poderoso do que eu; suas sandálias não sou digno de levar. Ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.

versos.grego: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ, καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.

controles.web: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
controles.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
controles.livre: Ele tem sua pá na mão; limpará sua eira, e recolherá seu trigo no celeiro; mas queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.

versos.grego: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάνην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
controles.kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
controles.livre: Então Jesus veio da Galileia ao Jordão até João para ser por ele batizado.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;

controles.web: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
controles.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
controles.livre: Mas João lhe impedia, dizendo: Eu preciso ser batizado por ti, e tu vens a mim?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἄφες ἄρτι· οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην. τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν.

controles.web: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus lhe respondeu: Permite por agora, porque assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça. Então ele o permitiu.

versos.grego: βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν Πνεῦμα Θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν·

controles.web: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
controles.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
controles.livre: E tendo Jesus sido batizado, subiu logo da água. E eis que os céus se abriram, e ele viu o Espírito de Deus descendo como uma pomba, vindo sobre ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.

controles.web: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
controles.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
controles.livre: E eis uma voz dos céus, dizendo: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me agrado.
